李青山忍不住暗自摇了摇头。

前世。

老爹也是这样，被爷拿捏了一辈子，后来爷年纪大了，还是自己父亲给养老送终，至于大伯和二伯，早就躲得远远了。

“李青山，你在干嘛？”

就在这时。

李老奎见李青山走到了自己身边，一脸懵逼的问道。

这小子？

干嘛呢？

“起开！”

李青山不爽的推了一下李青书，便伸手朝着桌子上的馏馍，大酱和炖白菜端起来，朝着自己的位置上走去。

饭桌上。

一片寂静。

所有人都是一脸震惊的望着李青山，简直不敢相信这小子的胆子这么大？

都敢上桌子直接把菜端走了？

“早晨喝地瓜汤，中午喝地瓜汤，晚上喝地瓜汤，都快把老子喝成地瓜了，今天换换口味。”

“爷，你不会不给我饭吃吧？”

李青山问道。

“我什么时候不给你饭吃了？”

“哪一天，少你一顿了？”

李老屯又怒了，旱烟杆子指着李青山道。

“闭嘴！”

李青山见大伯李大奎又要说话，顿时朝着李大奎瞪了过去道：“爷都说了，给我吃，你多什么嘴？”

“显着你了？”

“还有，我和李虎签的借条，是用新院子做的抵，但我又没说不还。”

“你……你小子……你用什么还？”

“你哪来的钱还？”

大伯李大奎怒道。

“还有一个月的时间，我准备明天开始上山打猎，打到的野物一卖，四十块钱还不是轻松就还上了？”

李青山道。

“上山打猎？”

“就你？”

“不怕送到黑瞎子嘴里去？”

“你会打猎吗？”

“青山，你疯了吧？”

“青山，可不能去老林子打猎。”

顿时。

饭桌上的老李家人，纷纷开口道。

李青山回到自己座位不再说话，大口大口的吃着刚刚端过来的饭菜。

与这些家伙说话，无异于对牛弹琴。

等到自己将猎物带回来了，也就都闭嘴了。

不过，这个家自己肯定是不可能继续待下去了，必须要分家才行。

但是现在不行。

现在分了没地方住，李老屯这老东西肯定不会分房子给自己家，要等到赵贵一家子找地方搬走才行。

“爹，爷，老林子可不是那么容易进去的。”

“李青山这小子要是在老林子里面死了，也就人死债消了，更何况新院子是爷爷的，又不是李青山的，李虎来要，就去找李青山的麻烦便是。”

“而且，要是李青山死在老林子里面，那可就好了。”

“三叔肯定一把年纪，肯定是不能生了，那三叔家可就断了香火，爷以后你就用不孝的名头压着他们家，还不得认打认罚？”

“到时候，我去找三叔商量，给他们养老。”

“这样的话，三叔这些年赚的钱，还不都得给我？”

“这可是好事情啊！”

李青书小声的对着李老屯和李大奎说道。

“咦！”

李青书话音落下，李大奎和李老屯相互对视一眼，发出一声轻咦道：“青书真不愧是咱们家最有出息的孩子，我怎么就没想到呢。”

“这，确实是好事！”

李大奎也开口道：“爹，年轻人不知天高地厚，火气大，稍微挑一挑，肯定会朝着老林子深处钻。”

“嗯！”

李老屯点了点头，旋即看向正在吃菜的李青山道：“小子，你要是能打一头三百斤的野猪回来，本事才叫大呢！”

李老屯

老小子，还对自己用激将法？

李青山决定将计就计，开口道：“爷，别说三百斤的野猪了，就是五百斤的野猪我也能给你扛回来。”

“不过，我这上山打猎的话，手里缺趁手的家伙。”

"爷，家里还有没有钱了，给我支援一点，我去买把枪回来，到时候你们就在家里等着吃肉享福吧。"

话音落下。

李老屯的脸色顿时阴沉了下来，开口道：“家里的钱还要给青书娶媳妇呢，哪来的什么闲钱？要怪就怪你爹他们赚不到钱，要不你爷我肯定给你钱去买枪！”

见李青山还要说话。

Li Qingshan couldn't help but shook his head secretly.

previous life.

The same is true for my father. He has been manipulated by me all his life. Later, when he got older, it was his father who took care of him until he died. As for the eldest uncle and the second uncle, they had long hidden away.

"Li Qingshan, what are you doing?"

Just then.

Li Laokui asked in confusion when he saw Li Qingshan coming to his side.

This guy?

What are you doing?

"Start!"

Li Qingshan pushed Li Qingshu unhappily, then reached out to pick up the steamed buns, miso and stewed cabbage on the table, and walked towards his seat.

On the dinner table.

There was silence.

Everyone looked at Li Qingshan in shock. They couldn't believe how brave this kid was?

How dare you go to the table and take the food away?

"I drink sweet potato soup in the morning, I drink sweet potato soup at noon, and I drink sweet potato soup in the evening. I'm almost turning into sweet potatoes. Let's change the taste today."

"Master, you won't deny me food, will you?"

Li Qingshan asked.

"When did I stop giving you food?"

"On what day will I miss a meal from you?"

Li Laotun was angry again and pointed the dry smoke pole at Li Qingshan.

"Shut up!"

When Li Qingshan saw that his uncle Li Dakui was about to speak again, he immediately glared at Li Dakui and said, "I already told you, give it to me, why are you so talkative?"

"Is it obvious to you?"

"Also, the IOU signed by Li Hu and I was paid for using the new yard, but I didn't say I wouldn't pay it back."

"You...you kid...what do you want in return?"

"Where did you get the money to pay back?"

Uncle Li Dakui said angrily.

"There's still a month left. I'm going to start hunting in the mountains tomorrow. Once I sell the wild animals I catch, won't it be easy to repay the forty yuan?"

Li Qingshan said.

"Go hunting in the mountains?"

"Just you?"

"Aren't you afraid of putting it in the mouth of the blind man?"

"Can you hunt?"

"Qingshan, are you crazy?"

"Qingshan, you can't go hunting in the old forest."

Suddenly.

Lao Li's family members at the dinner table spoke one after another.

Li Qingshan returned to his seat and stopped talking, eating the food that had just been served.

Talking to these guys is like playing the piano to an ox.

When they brought the prey back, they all shut up.

However, it is definitely impossible for the family to continue to stay in this family, and the family must be separated.

But not now.

Now that there is no place to live in the house, the old man Li Laotun will definitely not give him a house. He will have to wait until Zhao Gui and his family find a place to move out.

"Dad, Master, it's not easy to get into the old forest."

"If Li Qingshan dies in the old forest, his death debt will be wiped out. What's more, the new yard belongs to grandpa, not Li Qingshan. If Li Hu wants it, he will go to Li Qingshan's trouble."

"Besides, it would be great if Li Qingshan died in the old forest."

"Third uncle must be too old to have children. Then the family of third uncle will be cut off. From now on, sir, you will use the name of unfilial piety to oppress their family. Are you not allowed to accept punishment?"

"When the time comes, I will go to my third uncle to discuss how to support them in their old age."

"In this case, uncle San, don't you have to give me all the money he has earned over the years?"

"This is a good thing!"

Li Qingshu whispered to Li Laotun and Li Dakui.

"Eh!"

After Li Qingshu finished speaking, Li Dakui and Li Laotun looked at each other and exclaimed: "Qingshu is indeed the most promising child in our family. Why didn't I think of that?"

"This is indeed a good thing!"

Li Dakui also said: "Dad, young people don't know the heights of the world and are very angry. If they pick a little bit, they will definitely go deeper into the old forest."

"Yeah!"

Li Laotun nodded, then looked at Li Qingshan who was eating vegetables and said: "Boy, if you can bring back a three hundred kilogram wild boar, you will be very capable!"

Lilaotun

Old boy, are you still using aggressive methods on yourself?

Li Qingshan decided to use the trick and said: "Master, let alone a three hundred catty wild boar, I can even carry a five hundred catty wild boar back for you."

"However, if I go hunting in the mountains, I need someone to take advantage of me."

"Master, if your family still has any money, give me some support. I'll buy a gun and come back. Then you can wait at home to eat meat and enjoy your life."

The words fell.

Li Laotun's face suddenly darkened, and he said: "The money at home is used to help Qingshu marry a wife. Where is the spare money coming from? If you want to blame it, it's your father and the others who can't make money. Otherwise, your father, I will definitely give you money to buy a gun!"

He still wanted to talk when he saw Li Qingshan.
